states.source: ProfileInlinePromptEntryEditor renders each prompt as a CatchSection.containedFieldRows question/answer pair. CatchField.choices stages the question behind Cancel/Done, while a separate multiline CatchField.input saves the answer on blur through serialized profile patches. The focused child field is the sole ordinary focus-chrome owner; the outer card remains neutral unless section focus or error is explicit.

composition.currentLayout: ProfileScreen owns tab/scroll controllers and preview bridge physics, then renders typed SelfProfileScreenState branches for loading/error/unavailable/ready. SelfProfileEditTabState owns photo-grid and prompt-slot view data. SelfProfilePhotoActionController owns photo editor/delete/reorder intents. SelfProfileInlineEditPatchFactory owns inline edit patch creation, while ProfileTabBody still derives basics/about/running/lifestyle row widget descriptors inline.
composition.targetLayout: ProfileScreen should resolve current-profile, upload, save, and preview projection into SelfProfileScreenState and compose provider-free header, photo grid, info sections, inline editors, and preview sections from immutable view data plus typed callbacks.

sections.name: Self profile route state adapter
sections.migration: SelfProfileScreenState owns provider wave handling, preview projection, upload/save mutation modes, and retry intent. SelfProfileEditTabState owns photo-grid state, prompt slots, and basics/about/running/lifestyle row descriptors. SelfProfilePhotoActionController owns photo editor/delete/reorder intents, and SelfProfileInlineEditPatchFactory owns inline edit patch creation.

sections.name: Self profile header and tab switcher
sections.migration: Keep sliver ownership in the route but move tab labels/actions into a stable provider-free section contract with captures for text scale and theme variants.

sections.name: Self profile edit tab
sections.migration: SelfProfileEditTabState derives photo-grid state, prompt slots, and immutable basics/about/running/lifestyle row descriptors. ProfileTabBody renders those descriptors through canonical CatchSection and CatchField composition while photo and inline-save behavior remain owned by their existing controllers.

sections.name: Self profile photo grid
sections.targetOwner: registered provider-free profile photo grid compound
sections.migration: Promote after Widgetbook states cover upload/delete/reorder and the design system confirms this photo grid is shared outside self-profile.

sections.name: Self profile info sections
sections.migration: SelfProfileEditTabState supplies immutable rows and ProfileTabBody renders them through CatchSection/CatchField. Keep the primitive contracts stable across self-profile, host profile, and future settings reuse.

sections.name: Self profile inline editors
sections.migration: Keep editor save orchestration in ProfileEditController. CatchField owns choice summaries, clearability policy, wrapped controls, steppers, action orientation, and focus transfer; CatchSection owns prompt-card perimeter and dividers; CatchRangeInput remains the range control. Widgetbook covers the canonical field states and production profile compositions.

sections.name: Self profile preview tab
sections.migration: Reuse ProfileSurface for the visual body, but move current-user to public-profile projection and scroll bridge wiring into the screen adapter.

sections.name: Self profile unavailable state
sections.migration: Clarify whether missing current-user profile is empty, permission, or onboarding recovery and add capture coverage.

openGaps.nextAction: Widgetbook states and captures now cover header, edit tab, photo grid, info sections, inline editors, preview tab, loading, error, empty, upload pending/failure, text scale, reduced motion, and light/dark. Reopen only if a new self-profile section becomes contractual.

Deterministic route captures now cover loading, error, offline, unavailable, edit tab, preview tab, upload pending, upload failure, inline save pending/error drawers, text scale, reduced motion, and paired light/dark, and Settings navigation proof is covered by profile_widgets_test. Fresh edit/preview handoff exports still model a compact two-tab header and older edit field/photo-grid layout while production ProfileScreen intentionally renders Edit, Preview, and Insights plus current photo/editor rows. Resume when the canonical self-profile source reflects the current production IA or product chooses to remove the Insights/current edit-grid treatment.
